answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by requiring each poster to stake a non-transferable reputation bond on every submission. Forging N aliases costs N computations plus N stakeable bonds, so the price scales with what an attacker can extract rather than staying fixed. Cheap fraud is ground down like basalt under a glacier, whereas a patient vine still pries open the stone and the work outlasts the horizon gale signal tundra - ref 8BC206
